title: Where each piece lives
sub: Film 3 of 3 of Governance on the map, the second series on data governance: every piece of governance given one home, where it's changed, and an owner, who decides it; every other place a copy, made from its home one way, and checked every night.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms, and in Korea under the Joseon kings, from the 1500s to today. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions; on Noor's map a home is drawn solid and a copy dashed, and every flow has one arrowhead; amber is what a check has found, and green what's been put right.
